states.rationale: The injection-point control area is instance-owned shared state.
The auxiliary process array points into instance-owned shared memory.
The data-directory string is immutable after instance startup.
Each backend observes the supervisor's binary-upgrade mode value.
The computed backend capacity is immutable after shared-memory sizing.
The postmaster signal state points into instance-owned shared memory.
A new backend starts with the supervisor's latest reload timestamp.
All backends in an instance report the same server start timestamp.
The supervisor identity remains the host process identifier.
The prepared-transaction process array is instance-owned shared memory.
The process table header is instance-owned shared memory.
The process-signal header is instance-owned shared memory.
The shared-memory mapping address is owned for the instance lifetime.
The shared-memory segment identifier names an instance-owned resource.
Logger children inherit the supervisor's log-file epoch.
The descriptor budget is computed once for the server instance.
Each backend receives an independent value copy of the executable path.
The postmaster child-slot count is fixed after shared-memory sizing.
Each backend receives an independent value copy of the library path.
The liveness descriptors remain process-owned and must not be closed by a role.
A backend starts with the supervisor's query identifier capability flag.
A backend inherits whether server output redirection is active.
Logging pipe descriptors remain process-owned shared resources.
The calibrated timing frequency is immutable for the host process.
